# AL1002: Don't divide by constant zero

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| -- | -- |

| Category | `Reliability` |

| Analyzer | `Al1002DontDivideByConstantZeroAnalyzer` |

## Description

Integers and Decimal should never be divided by the constant 0 as this causes a DivideByZeroException at runtime.
